name: Chemistry
boundaries: Fundamental and applied chemistry, including synthesis, catalysis, materials and molecular systems. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance is chemical; exclude routine process optimization.

original_dispositions.reason: Added as CHM-11. Overlaps CHM-04 and CHM-05.

original_dispositions.original_title: De novo artificial enzymes for arbitrary reactions
Ambient nitrogen fixation at industrial performance

original_dispositions.reason: Added as CHM-12, narrower than the historical “>90% selectivity below 100 °C” slogan.

original_dispositions.original_title: Artificial photosynthesis above 20% for water splitting or CO2 reduction
original_dispositions.reason: Solar-to-hydrogen above 20% is already reported for photovoltaic electrolysis, cited under CHM-07. Multicarbon CO2 supply is CHM-07. A molecular Z-scheme that merely copies a result photovoltaics plus electrolyzers already achieve for hydrogen would not be a separate revolution.

original_dispositions.original_title: Synthetic self-replicating system with open-ended Darwinian evolution, preferably without DNA, RNA, or proteins
Perfect quantum or field control of any reaction pathway
original_dispositions.reason: Case-by-case electric-field effects do not establish a universal reagent, and stating 100% selectivity for every reaction would inflate the evidence.
Covered jointly by CHM-10 and CHM-04. Not given a new identity.

original_dispositions.original_title: Exact routine solution of the Schrödinger equation for large molecules
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by CHM-01. The desktop and sub-1 kcal/mol details are performance wishes inside that concept.

original_dispositions.original_title: Universal quantitative chemical recycling of all plastics to monomers
original_dispositions.reason: Added in narrowed form as CHM-13. The historical absolute wording was not kept.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Clarified that an exact Schrödinger solver and a reliable empirical predictor are the same capability if both predict unseen reactions. Added Antypov and Rosseinsky on the difference between a computed structure and a discovery.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The historical “desktop, hundreds of atoms, under 1 kcal/mol” picture is recorded as one performance wish, not a new concept.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Stated explicitly that the strict form excludes DNA, RNA, and protein machinery.
Stated that recoverable metallic hydrogen, as a high-pressure phase, is not a second concept.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: It is the same unsolved materials problem.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Flagged the molecular assembler as shared territory: flask-scale molecules belong to CHM-04, specified macroscopic solids to CHM-10.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Neither entry was merged or removed.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Flagged overlap with nitrogen fixation, methane oxidation, and C–H editing without absorbing those entries.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: A general design method does not automatically solve each hard reaction, and each hard reaction could in principle be solved without a general enzyme designer.
The GJ-per-tonne source still would not open.
A greater-than-20% hydrogen system is not described as missing. The multicarbon supply gap is unchanged.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Explicitly separated solid-state lithium-metal batteries from the air-breathing cell.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Solid-state lithium-metal batteries raise the ceiling of an existing class. They are not this capability.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Added the Antypov and Rosseinsky warning.

reconciliation_change_log.reason: The molecular assembler is shared territory.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Added CHM-11. General C–H site selection is a change in synthetic logic, not only a longer list of useful reactions.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: It was rejected in the first pass as overlapping CHM-04 and CHM-05. Those overlaps are real and are now flagged. The bond-selection capability is still distinct.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Added CHM-12. The entry is narrowed to the selectivity-conversion barrier and to stranded or flared gas.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Direct methane-to-methanol was rejected in the first pass because methanol already exists. The revised standard allows a radical change in accessibility. It does not claim replacement of world-scale syngas plants.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Added CHM-13. The revolutionary scope is mixed waste at energy and cost below virgin monomer.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Universal plastic recycling was rejected in the first pass because laboratory polyolefin yields had become high. The revised entry keeps that fact. The impossible “every polymer, zero energy, zero by-product” version was not adopted.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Not added: coherent control or oriented electric fields as a universal reagent.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Specific field effects are real. A preparative method that steers any reaction to one product is not supported as a near-term chemical principle, and the strongest primary statements are still vision papers about particular reactions.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Water-splitting artificial photosynthesis above 20% solar-to-hydrogen was not added.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Photovoltaic electrolysis has already reported that regime.
